grega_core.travel.portal_opened: The glyph has opened the portal.
grega_core.travel.portal_frame: Target a complete portal frame, valid Twilight pool or Elven Gateway Core, and meet its native structure and mana requirements.
grega_core.travel.home_bound: Home set at a safe position nearby.
grega_core.travel.no_home: First cast Self → Set Home in the Overworld.
grega_core.travel.rtp_arrived: Wander has found a new place to explore.
grega_core.travel.unsafe: No safe arrival point found. Clear the area or try again shortly.
grega_core.travel.cooldown: Travel magic is recharging (60 seconds after a successful trip).
grega_core.travel.overworld_only: Bind home and use random travel in the Overworld.
grega_core.travel.overworld_or_nether: Nether portals can be opened in the Overworld or Nether.
grega_core.travel.unavailable: Dismount and wake up before using travel magic.
grega_core.glyph_desc.glyph_open_portal: Touch → Open Portal. Cast on a complete obsidian frame, Twilight Forest pool, Aether frame or Elven Gateway Core. Native frame, dimension and mana requirements still apply. Ordinary ignition, diamonds, water buckets and the Wand of the Forest no longer activate these gateways.
grega_core.glyph_desc.glyph_set_home: Self → Set Home. Save a safe position near your feet in the Overworld. The saved home survives death.
grega_core.glyph_desc.glyph_home: Self → Homeward. Return from any dimension to your saved Overworld home. Shares a 60-second cooldown with Wander. Unsafe homes are rejected; failed searches have a 5-second delay.
grega_core.glyph_desc.glyph_rtp: Self → Wander. In the Overworld, search up to eight safe surface positions 512–2048 blocks from world spawn. Shares a 60-second cooldown with Homeward; a failed search has a 5-second delay.
grega_core.travel.use_touch: Use Touch → Open Portal on an inner frame face, Twilight pool or Elven Gateway Core.
grega_core.travel.use_self: Travel effects require the Self cast method.
totemic.ceremony.grega_core.rubber_awake: Transforms nearby Oak Saplings into Rubber Saplings
grega_core.ceremony.rubber_awakening.ove: The $(thing)Song of Latex$() transforms all $(item)Oak Saplings$() within 6 blocks of the Totem Base into $(item)Rubber Saplings$().$(br2)Select it with a $(l:instruments/rattle)Rattle$(/l) and an $(l:instruments/eagle_bone_whistle)Eagle-Bone Whistle$(/l).
